i"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"nstalled tmap would redo it:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## What your agent gets"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### The firmware map"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Each candidate is one point on the map, annotated on several equal layers: where the data comes
from"},{"id":"p27s2","text":", how much of it an attacker controls, who wrote the value, how the spot is reached, whether
anythin"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"g filters it on the way, and whether the function was fully analyzed. Each layer reads
**YES**, **NO"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"** or an explicit **UNKNOWN** that says what is missing and why."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"There is no score. The default view puts the highest-impact calls that nothing has proven safe first"},{"id":"p28s2","text":";
your agent can re-sort or filter by any layer. Re-sorting changes the order, never the set of
cand"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"idates. In every view, only a *proven-safe* fact can push a candidate down; an UNKNOWN never can."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Command-execution, buffer-copy and format-string calls come with in-function argument provenance.

text-lev"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"el reading, and is marked as such."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### The patch diff"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"`tmap diff` compares every binary whose content changed, in parallel, running Ghidra, BinExport and
"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"BinDiff end to end — you never handle an intermediate file. (`--binary NAME` limits it to one.)"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **A function-level patch view.** One entry per changed function pair, grouped by what happened
aro"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"und its dangerous calls: a call that now goes somewhere else, a dangerous call that is still
there, "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"a reading that could not be decided. By default the entries most likely to matter come
first; other "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"orderings are a switch away.
- **What a similarity score misses.** BinDiff's similarity ignores cons"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"tants: a function can read
`similarity=1.0` while a buffer length went from `0x40` to `0x3f`. tmap a"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"dds an

length constant at a copy or format call.

"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"modern agent already reads and reasons about one function well. What it cannot do is cover a whole
r"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"oot filesystem, or every changed binary between two releases, the same way twice — or say where it
d"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"id not look. That is the half Treasure Map does."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- **UNKNOWN is never "safe".** A fact it could not establish stays UNKNOWN; a binary the diff could
"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"not analyze never reads as unchanged.
- **Leads, not verdicts.** A candidate is a lead to verify, no"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"t a confirmed vulnerability; a changed
function is a change to review, not a confirmed fix. Reachabi"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"lity is graded one function at a time
— this is **not** a taint-propagation engine, and it never cla"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"ims a path is unreachable.
- **Judgments that accumulate.** Your agent's conclusions live in an anno"},{"id":"p35s6","text":"tation layer over the
read-only facts, so a multi-session audit picks up where it left off — with an"},{"id":"p35s7","text":"y model or agent. A
judgment is flagged for review again the moment the facts under it change."}],"truncated":true}
